mapper.sql: pk_id, id, tenant_id, flag_key, enabled, config_json, is_deleted, gmt_created, gmt_modified, gmt_deleted
mapper.select: SELECT FROM feature_flag WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY flag_key ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO feature_flag( id, tenant_id, flag_key, enabled, config_json, is_deleted, gmt_created, gmt_modified, gmt_deleted ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{tenantId}, #{flagKey}, #{enabled}, #{configJson}, #{isDeleted}, #{gmtCreated}, #{gmtModified}, #{gmtDeleted} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE enabled = VALUES(enabled), config_json = VALUES(config_json), gmt_modified = VALUES(gmt_modified)
